labelPolicy.scope: Staged specialist for PS-critical visible e-waste components; the existing broad classifier remains unchanged.
labelPolicy.unknownPolicy: Abstain on low confidence; missing classes remain manual-only. A softmax model does not reliably reject every unknown object.
labelPolicy.compositionPolicy: No chemical composition, elemental percentage, purity or price is inferred by this classifier.
labelPolicy.reviewPolicy: Visual review before training or prediction. Keep correct difficult examples. Exclude drawings, wrong subjects and ambiguous material labels; record decisions by content hash.
